objective: Choose one evidence-recovery next step after the completed Coffee exit-2 observation without making another request.

evidence_basis.authority: reviewed planning evidence and durable candidate-only diagnostics

detector_false_positive_risk.explanation: The first detector stopped on a document-wide captcha substring. Script-only captcha text is now a deterministic negative fixture, but raw HTML was intentionally not retained, so the two historical matches cannot be reclassified conclusively.

environment_access_risk.explanation: Both exact official URLs returned HTTP 200 with no redirect, yet the retained evidence lacks visible title, widget, challenge-markup, route, or access-denial proof. Normal cloud access may be usable, but that remains unverified.

live_technique_failure.explanation: The stop condition fired before normalization, so the live product-detail parser never had an opportunity to prove or fail identity, attributable price, coffee semantics, or provenance gates.

evidence_retention_failure.explanation: Evidence-before-exit durably retained the request ledger and sanitized diagnostics, repairing the original no-evidence failure mode. It retained no product record, so both Coffee candidate evidence gaps and repeatability remain open.

criteria.rationale: Rewards the option most likely to reduce an evidence uncertainty with attributable retained output.
Rewards reusable learning across sources or source roles without treating breadth as quality.
A higher score means fewer bounded requests, less compliance uncertainty, and less coordination cost.
Rewards direct resolution of Roots/Nana identity, price, provenance, and repeatability gaps.
Rewards closure of explicit Candidate Learning Evidence and reviewed-claim dependencies.

options.description: Queue one separately authorized bounded rerun with the hardened detector on the same Roots and Nana official product-detail URLs.

score_rationale.expected_evidence_gain: The only prior stop may be detector-induced, and the hardened detector allows the live parser to be evaluated while preserving evidence before exit.
score_rationale.cross_source_reuse_value: Two specialty-roaster details test reusable canonical identity, displayed-price, semantic, provenance, and repeatability behavior.
score_rationale.incremental_request_risk_efficiency: The same two public official URLs fit a four-attempt maximum with no retry, pagination, browser, session, or scope expansion.
score_rationale.coffee_gap_resolution: It is the only option that can directly produce the missing Roots/Nana product, price, provenance, and repeat observations.
score_rationale.dependency_reduction: A valid outcome can advance CLE-000006 and CLE-000007 and clarify the related Coffee claim chain, though independent review remains necessary.

options.description: Move next to Q-Diving evidence recovery across SSI Blog, Scubadoo Koh Tao, and Aquamaster Thailand.

score_rationale.expected_evidence_gain: Three distinct content, course-service, and retail-product roles offer broad uncertainty reduction.
score_rationale.cross_source_reuse_value: The three-role package has the greatest transfer breadth.
score_rationale.incremental_request_risk_efficiency: It requires three current surfaces, three repeat paths, separate parsers, Deep Audit, Human Review, and registry decisions.
score_rationale.coffee_gap_resolution: It cannot resolve the open Roots/Nana evidence gap.
score_rationale.dependency_reduction: It can advance three candidate records and eleven reviewed claims after a substantially larger package.

options.description: Stop Coffee recovery for now and retain the completed exit-2 observation as candidate-only negative evidence.

score_rationale.expected_evidence_gain: It preserves the existing negative diagnostic but generates no new evidence.
score_rationale.cross_source_reuse_value: The retained detector lesson is reusable, while live extraction remains unevaluated.
score_rationale.incremental_request_risk_efficiency: It incurs no further request or access risk.
score_rationale.coffee_gap_resolution: It records a stop decision but leaves both product-evidence and repeatability gaps open.
score_rationale.dependency_reduction: Candidate evidence remains unresolved and no reviewed claim gains new support.

recommendation.reason: A is the smallest bounded action that can distinguish the unresolved detector/access question from live technique performance and directly close the Roots/Nana product-evidence gap. B has higher breadth but does not resolve Coffee and costs substantially more; C preserves safety but leaves the specific gap untouched.

sequence: Write a fresh prepared evidence artifact and pending ledger before any request.
Make one observation per source with the hardened detector and retain sanitized response/normalization evidence before continuing.
Stop that source if the first observation has confirmed access-boundary evidence or cannot yield attributable identity plus price; a second observation could no longer satisfy two-of-two Deep Audit.
Make the second observation only for a source whose first strict product record passed, then evaluate repeatability and Deep Audit.
Never auto-rerun, escalate environment, or promote candidate evidence.

withheld_evidence.condition: No confirmed access boundary occurred, but any strict identity, price, semantic, provenance, two-of-two repeatability, or Deep Audit gate failed.

new_access_boundary.action: Stop the affected source without browser, Edge, session, proxy, authentication, challenge handling, or automatic rerun.

technical_failure.condition: Transport, runtime, request-budget, or evidence-writing failure.
technical_failure.action: Write available technical evidence, stop, and require separate review before any retry.
